items.title: Bob Rosengarden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 6, 1996
items.q: Doc Severinsen of course was there, all of — Tommy Newsom as a matter of fact was in that band. Hymie Shertzer from Benny Goodman. Clark Terry, Snooky Young, all giants, you know, musical giants.

ctx.x: When the big band era kind of faded out, a lot of the musicians found a home —

Oh yes, it was the best job. You don’t have to travel anymore. You stayed home and the money was good, and you were treated nicely, and if you worked — this was before tapes, so you had to be there live, you know the live shows. And then Carson came along. And Skitch again went right in with that. And he was the band leader on the first Carson show. And that was a wonderful band, it was great band. Doc Severinsen of course was there, all of — Tommy Newsom as a matter of fact was in that band. Hymie Shertzer from…
I was going to ask you when you showed up for a day at work at NBC, did you know what was in store for you that day?
